fusions.name: Banked Heat Let Go
fusions.desc: Releases heat from under your scales, dealing 11 fire damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and setting them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Embers Tallied
fusions.desc: Presses a hot claw into the target, dealing 16 fire damage, and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Coals in the Seams
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Inner Kiln
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, a bolt of fire strikes the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds. You have 10% fire resistance.
